web-guide-idea-28.audience: Supporters of local performers and people looking for a curated evening.
web-guide-idea-28.offer: Produce a small online showcase with consenting artists and original or cleared material. Your hosting, running order and introductions make the event feel complete.
web-guide-idea-28.steps.1: Introduce each artist and keep transitions smooth.
web-guide-idea-28.steps.2: Close with a joint conversation and where audiences can follow the artists.
web-guide-idea-28.equipment: A phone can host a small local setup; use tested audio, stable internet and a moderator for multiple performers.
web-guide-idea-28.returnReason: Curate different themes and line-ups. A dependable show gives people a reason to watch emerging talent again.
web-guide-idea-28.promotion: Introduce the confirmed performers and a short approved sample from each.

web-guide-idea-28.metadataDescription: Bring consenting musicians, poets or comedians together for a hosted online showcase of original work. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
